name: Adelgeia
source: The young priestess Eris wanders into the Star-God's shrine and has a fateful meeting with a mysterious man named Arve who has lost his memories. As her village is attacked, the both of them set out on a journey to retrieve the man's memories and to stop those who left her with no place to come back to.
translation: 年轻的女祭司厄里斯徘徊在星神的神殿中，与失去记忆的神秘男子阿尔夫发生了命运般的相遇。当她的村庄遭到袭击时，她们俩踏上了寻找男人记忆的旅程，并阻止那些让她无处可归的人。
